summary: Concurrent UPDATE statements on a single row in a small table experience significant delays due to locking contention.
symptoms: UPDATE statements take minutes to complete despite the small table size.
Exclusive locks are observed on the target row during concurrent updates.
mechanism: Row-level locking contention caused by multiple concurrent updates targeting the same row.
